<style>
/* ── Circuit Pulse Animation Base ── */
.circuit-pulse-animation {
  background-color: #F3F7F4;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── ERP Logo Marquee ── */
.auto-tab-erp-marquee-wrapper.is-gray .auto-tab-erp-marquee-item,
.auto-tab-erp-marquee-wrapper.is-color .auto-tab-erp-marquee-item {
  height: auto;
  will-change: transform;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}
.auto-tab-erp-marquee-wrapper.is-gray {
  filter: grayscale(1);
  opacity: 0.4;
}
.auto-tab-erp-marquee-wrapper.is-color {
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom,
    rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 40%,
    rgba(0,0,0,1) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 100%);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom,
    rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 40%,
    rgba(0,0,0,1) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 100%);
}
/* ── End ERP Logo Marquee ── */

/* ── Construction Table Orchestrated Reveal ── */

/* Everything starts hidden, only animates when .is-animated is added */
.construction-table-item:not(.cc-table-header) {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-20px);
}
.construction-table-features-item-bg {
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
}
.construction-table-features-cell:first-child .construction-table-checkmark {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.3);
}
.construction-table-features-cell:last-child .construction-table-checkmark {
  opacity: 0;
}
.construction-table-item:not(.cc-table-header) .construction-table-text-wrapper {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-10px);
}

/* Animated states */
.construction-table-item.is-animated {
  animation: rowSlideIn 0.8s ease-out forwards;
}
.construction-table-item.is-animated .construction-table-text-wrapper {
  animation: textReveal 0.7s ease-out forwards;
  animation-delay: 0.1s;
}
.construction-table-item.is-animated .construction-table-features-item-bg {
  animation: cellSweep 1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: 0.2s;
}
.construction-table-item.is-animated .construction-table-features-cell:first-child .construction-table-checkmark {
  animation: checkPop 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: 0.7s;
}
.construction-table-item.is-animated .construction-table-features-cell:last-child .construction-table-checkmark {
  animation: xFade 0.6s ease-out forwards;
  animation-delay: 0.9s;
}

@keyframes rowSlideIn {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-20px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
}
@keyframes cellSweep {
  0% { transform: scaleX(0); }
  100% { transform: scaleX(1); }
}
@keyframes checkPop {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.3); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
@keyframes xFade {
  0% { opacity: 0; }
  100% { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes textReveal {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-10px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
}
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  var frozenCanvases = new Set();
  var THRESHOLD = 0.5;
  var FADE_MS = 800;
  var DELAY_MS = 300;

  var origDI = CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.drawImage;
  CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.drawImage = function() {
    if (frozenCanvases.has(this.canvas)) return;
    return origDI.apply(this, arguments);
  };

  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
    mutations.forEach(function(m) {
      m.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
        if (node.tagName === 'CANVAS' && node.closest && node.closest('.home-rive-img')) {
          frozenCanvases.add(node);
          node.style.opacity = '0';
          node.style.transition = 'opacity ' + FADE_MS + 'ms ease';
        }
      });
    });
  });
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    mo.disconnect();
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        var canvas = entry.target.querySelector('canvas');
        if (canvas) {
          setTimeout(function() {
            frozenCanvases.delete(canvas);
            canvas.style.opacity = '1';
          }, DELAY_MS);
        }
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      });
    }, { threshold: THRESHOLD });

    document.querySelectorAll('.home-rive-img').forEach(function(el) {
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  });
})();

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  // ─── CONFIG ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const CONTAINER   = ".auto-tabs-sm";
  const ITEM        = ".auto-tabs-sm_item";
  const HEADER      = ".auto-tabs_sm-header";
  const BODY        = ".auto-tabs_sm-body";
  const ACTIVE_CLASS = "is-active";
  const SCROLL_OFFSET = 64; // px above the container when scrolling
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const container = document.querySelector(CONTAINER);
  if (!container) return;

  const items = container.querySelectorAll(ITEM);

  // ── Helper: get natural scrollHeight for smooth transition
  function expandBody(bodyEl) {
    bodyEl.style.maxHeight = bodyEl.scrollHeight + "px";
    bodyEl.style.opacity   = "1";
  }

  function collapseBody(bodyEl) {
    bodyEl.style.maxHeight = "0px";
    bodyEl.style.opacity   = "0";
  }

  // ── Inject base transition styles programmatically
  // (avoids touching Webflow's style panel)
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    ${BODY} {
      overflow: hidden;
      max-height: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: max-height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
                  opacity    0.32s ease;
    }
    ${HEADER} {
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }
    ${ITEM}.${ACTIVE_CLASS} ${HEADER} {
      /* Optional: style active header differently via CSS in Webflow */
    }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  // ── Open a specific item, close all others
  function openItem(activeItem) {
    items.forEach(function (item) {
      const body   = item.querySelector(BODY);
      const isThis = item === activeItem;

      if (isThis) {
        item.classList.add(ACTIVE_CLASS);
        expandBody(body);
      } else {
        item.classList.remove(ACTIVE_CLASS);
        collapseBody(body);
      }
    });
  }

  // ── Scroll to top of the container (smooth)
  function scrollToContainer() {
    const top =
      container.getBoundingClientRect().top +
      window.pageYOffset -
      SCROLL_OFFSET;

    window.scrollTo({ top: top, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  // ── Bind click events to every header
  items.forEach(function (item) {
    const header = item.querySelector(HEADER);
    if (!header) return;

    header.addEventListener("click", function () {
      const isAlreadyOpen = item.classList.contains(ACTIVE_CLASS);

      // openItem(isAlreadyOpen ? null : item);
    });
  });

  // ── Open first item by default
  if (items.length > 0) {
    openItem(items[0]);
  }

});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const counters = document.querySelectorAll("[data-count]");

  function easeOutCubic(t) {
    return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
  }

  function formatNumber(num, originalText) {
    const hasComma = originalText.includes(",");
    const hasDecimal = originalText.includes(".");

    let formatted = hasDecimal
      ? num.toFixed(originalText.split(".")[1].length)
      : Math.round(num).toString();

    if (hasComma) {
      formatted = Number(formatted).toLocaleString();
    }

    return formatted;
  }

  function animateCounter(el) {
    const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
    const originalText = el.textContent.trim();
    const duration = parseInt(el.dataset.duration) || 1600;

    let startTime = null;

    function update(time) {
      if (!startTime) startTime = time;

      const progress = Math.min((time - startTime) / duration, 1);
      const eased = easeOutCubic(progress);

      const current = target * eased;

      el.textContent = formatNumber(current, originalText);

      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(update);
      } else {
        el.textContent = formatNumber(target, originalText);
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        animateCounter(entry.target);
        obs.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.5 });

  counters.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

});
</script></div></div></div></div><div data-wf--section-borders---left-right--variant="dark" class="container-borders <script>

(function rollNumbers({
  selector = '.span-number',
  duration = 1.4,
  ease = 'power4.out',
  delay = 0.15
} = {}) {
  
  function createStack(finalDigit, isUp) {
    const wrapper = document.createElement('span');
    wrapper.className = `span-roll-wrapper ${isUp ? 'up' : 'down'}`;
    wrapper.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;';
    
    const stack = document.createElement('span');
    stack.className = 'span-roll-stack';
    stack.style.cssText = 'display:block;will-change:transform;';
    
    // Генерируем 4 случайные цифры
    const randomDigits = Array.from({length: 3}, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10));
    const digits = isUp 
      ? [...randomDigits, parseInt(finalDigit)]
      : [parseInt(finalDigit), ...randomDigits];
    
    digits.forEach(d => {
      const el = document.createElement('span');
      el.textContent = d;
      el.style.cssText = 'display:block;line-height:1;';
      stack.appendChild(el);
    });
    
    wrapper.appendChild(stack);
    return { wrapper, stack, isUp };
  }
  
  function updatePositions(items) {
    items.forEach(item => {
      const firstChild = item.stack.children[0];
      const digitHeight = firstChild.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      const count = item.stack.children.length;
      
  
      item.wrapper.style.height = `${digitHeight}px`;
      
  
      item.finalY = item.isUp ? -(count - 1) * digitHeight : 0;
      
   
      if (item._played) {
        gsap.set(item.stack, { y: item.finalY });
      } else {
    
        const startY = item.isUp ? 0 : -(count - 1) * digitHeight;
        gsap.set(item.stack, { y: startY });
      }
    });
  }
  
  function init() {
    const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector))
      .filter(s => /^\d$/.test(s.textContent.trim()));
    
    const items = spans.map((span, idx) => {
      const finalDigit = span.textContent.trim();
      const isUp = (idx % 2 === 1);
      const { wrapper, stack } = createStack(finalDigit, isUp);
      
      span.replaceWith(wrapper);
      
      return { wrapper, stack, isUp, _played: false };
    });
    
  
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      updatePositions(items);
      
    
      const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          const item = items.find(i => i.wrapper === entry.target);
          if (!item || item._played || !entry.isIntersecting) return;
          
          item._played = true;
          setTimeout(() => {
            gsap.to(item.stack, { 
              y: item.finalY, 
              duration, 
              ease,
              force3D: true
            });
          }, delay * 1000);
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.5 });
      
      items.forEach(i => io.observe(i.wrapper));
    });
    
 
    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
      resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        updatePositions(items);
      }, 100); // Debounce 100ms
    });
  }
  
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
      setTimeout(init, 100);
    });
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(init, 100));
  }
})();



</script>

<script>

  
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const menuContainer = document.querySelector('.nav_menu');
  const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown');
  const background = document.querySelector('.nav_menu-background');
  let timeoutId;

  if (!menuContainer || !dropdowns.length || !background) {
    return;
  }

 
  const clearTimeoutHandler = () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  
  const handleMouseEnter = (event) => {
 
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    timeoutId = null;

    const dropdown = event.currentTarget;
    dropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-active'));
    dropdown.classList.add('is-active');

    const contentWrapper = dropdown.querySelector('.list-content-wrapper');
    if (contentWrapper) {
      const contentHeight = contentWrapper.offsetHeight;
  
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        background.style.height = `${contentHeight}px`;
        background.style.opacity = '1';
      });
    }
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
  
    if (timeoutId) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
    
    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      dropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-active'));
     
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        background.style.height = '0px';
        background.style.opacity = '0';
      });
    }, 200);
  };

  const setupDesktopNav = () => {
    dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
      dropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', handleMouseEnter);
      dropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    });
    
    menuContainer.addEventListener('mouseenter', clearTimeoutHandler);
    menuContainer.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  };

  const teardownDesktopNav = () => {
   
    if (timeoutId) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      timeoutId = null;
    }
    
    dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
      dropdown.removeEventListener('mouseenter', handleMouseEnter);
      dropdown.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    });
    
    menuContainer.removeEventListener('mouseenter', clearTimeoutHandler);
    menuContainer.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    
    
    dropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-active'));
    background.style.height = '0px';
    background.style.opacity = '0';
  };

  let isDesktop = window.innerWidth > 991;

  if (isDesktop) {
    setupDesktopNav();
  }


  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      const newIsDesktop = window.innerWidth > 991;
      if (newIsDesktop === isDesktop) return;

      isDesktop = newIsDesktop;
      if (isDesktop) {
        setupDesktopNav();
      } else {
        teardownDesktopNav();
      }
    }, 100);
  });


  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    if (timeoutId) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
    if (resizeTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    }
  });
});
  
  
</script>

<script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            const speed = 5000; // Autoplay speed in milliseconds
            
            document.querySelectorAll(".carousel-wrapper").forEach(carouselWrapper => {
                const links = carouselWrapper.querySelectorAll(".carousel-link");
                const cards = carouselWrapper.querySelectorAll(".carousel_cms-item");
                
                // Check if required elements exist
                if (!links.length || !cards.length) {
                    console.warn("Carousel elements not found");
                    return;
                }
                
                let current = 0;
                let interval = null;
                let autoplayActive = false;
                
                // Set progress bar width with optional transition
                const setBarWidth = (index, width, transition = "none") => {
                    const bar = links[index]?.querySelector(".carousel-progress-fill");
                    if (!bar) return;
                    bar.style.transition = transition;
                    bar.style.width = width;
                };
                
                // Reset all progress bars to 0%
                const resetAllBars = () => {
                    links.forEach((_, i) => setBarWidth(i, "0%"));
                };
                
                // Update active link styling
                const updateActiveLink = (index) => {
                    links.forEach(link => link.classList.remove("is-active"));
                    if (links[index]) {
                        links[index].classList.add("is-active");
                    }
                };
                
                // Filter and show cards based on category
                
                const filterCards = (category) => {
                    const cat = category.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    
                    cards.forEach(card => {
                        const tags = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll(".category-tag"))
                            .map(tag => tag.textContent.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '));
        
                        card.style.display = tags.includes(cat) ? "block" : "none";
                    });
                };
              
                // Animate progress bar from 0% to 100%
                const animateProgressBar = (index) => {
                    // Reset to 0% without transition
                    setBarWidth(index, "0%");
                    // Force reflow to ensure the reset takes effect
                    if (links[index]) {
                        void links[index].offsetWidth;
                        // Animate to 100%
                        setBarWidth(index, "100%", `width ${speed}ms linear`);
                    }
                };
                
                // Change to a specific slide
                const changeSlide = (newIndex, userInitiated = false) => {
                    // Validate index
                    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= links.length) return;
                    
                    resetAllBars();
                    current = newIndex;
                    updateActiveLink(current);
                    
                    const targetCategory = links[current].dataset.target;
                    if (targetCategory) {
                        filterCards(targetCategory);
                    }
                    
                    if (userInitiated) {
                        // User clicked - set bar to 100% immediately
                        setBarWidth(current, "100%");
                    } else if (autoplayActive) {
                        // Autoplay - animate the progress bar
                        animateProgressBar(current);
                    }
                };
                
                // Start autoplay functionality
                const startAutoplay = () => {
                    if (autoplayActive || !links.length) return;
                    
                    autoplayActive = true;
                    changeSlide(current, false);
                    
                    interval = setInterval(() => {
                        const nextIndex = (current + 1) % links.length;
                        changeSlide(nextIndex, false);
                    }, speed);
                };
                
                // Stop autoplay functionality
                const stopAutoplay = () => {
                    if (!autoplayActive) return;
                    
                    autoplayActive = false;
                    if (interval) {
                        clearInterval(interval);
                        interval = null;
                    }
                    // Set current bar to 100% when stopping
                    setBarWidth(current, "100%");
                };
                
                // Add click event listeners to navigation links
                links.forEach((link, index) => {
                    link.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        stopAutoplay();
                        changeSlide(index, true);
                    });
                });
                
                // Intersection Observer for autoplay when in viewport
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            startAutoplay();
                        } else {
                            stopAutoplay();
                        }
                    });
                }, {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: "0px",
                    threshold: 0.1
                });
                
                // Initialize carousel
                if (links.length > 0) {
                    updateActiveLink(current);
                    const initialCategory = links[current].dataset.target;
                    if (initialCategory) {
                        filterCards(initialCategory);
                    }
                    resetAllBars();
                }
                
                // Start observing the carousel wrapper
                observer.observe(carouselWrapper);
            });
        });
    </script>

<!-- Global horizontal-border intersection fix.
     Patches any wide element drawing only a horizontal border (top/bottom, no sides)
     by redrawing it as an inset pseudo-element. Prevents 1px visual overlap with
     vertical .container-borders site-wide. Works on any dark or light section. -->
<script>
(function () {
  function patchHorizontalLines() {
    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.hasAttribute('data-hline-patched')) return;

      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      const bt = parseFloat(cs.borderTopWidth);
      const bb = parseFloat(cs.borderBottomWidth);
      const bl = parseFloat(cs.borderLeftWidth);
      const br = parseFloat(cs.borderRightWidth);

      const hasHorizontal = bt > 0 || bb > 0;
      const hasVertical = bl > 0 || br > 0;
      if (!hasHorizontal || hasVertical) return;

      if (el.getBoundingClientRect().width < 200) return;

      el.setAttribute('data-hline-patched', '');
      if (cs.position === 'static') el.style.position = 'relative';

      if (bt > 0) {
        el.style.setProperty('--hline-top-color', cs.borderTopColor);
        el.style.borderTopColor = 'transparent';
      }
      if (bb > 0) {
        el.style.setProperty('--hline-bottom-color', cs.borderBottomColor);
        el.style.borderBottomColor = 'transparent';
      }
    });
  }

  function init() {
    patchHorizontalLines();

    let scheduled = false;
    const mo = new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        patchHorizontalLines();
        scheduled = false;
      });
    });
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

    pointer-events: none;

<!-- Unified Animation Observer -->
<script>
(function() {

  /* ── Construction Table: trigger row animations on visibility ── */
  var tableItems = document.querySelectorAll(".construction-table-item:not(.cc-table-header)");
  if (tableItems.length) {
    var stagger = 400;
    var tableObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        var wrapper = entry.target.closest(".tab-table-wrapper") || entry.target.parentElement;
        var rows = wrapper.querySelectorAll(".construction-table-item:not(.cc-table-header)");
        rows.forEach(function(row, i) {
          if (row.classList.contains("is-animated")) return;
          setTimeout(function() {
            row.classList.add("is-animated");
          }, i * stagger);
        });
        tableObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.2 });

    var observed = [];
    tableItems.forEach(function(item) {
      var wrapper = item.closest(".tab-table-wrapper") || item.parentElement;
      if (observed.indexOf(wrapper) === -1) {
        observed.push(wrapper);
        tableObserver.observe(item);
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── Marquee: JS-driven scroll ── */
  var marqueeWrappers = document.querySelectorAll(".auto-tab-erp-marquee-wrapper");
  if (marqueeWrappers.length) {
    var allMarqueeItems = document.querySelectorAll(".auto-tab-erp-marquee-item");
    allMarqueeItems.forEach(function(item) {
      item.style.animation = "none";
      item.style.webkitAnimation = "none";
    });

    var containers = [];
    marqueeWrappers.forEach(function(wrapper) {
      var parent = wrapper.closest(".auto-tab-animated-content-wrapper");
      if (!parent) return;
      var existing = null;
      for (var c = 0; c < containers.length; c++) {
        if (containers[c].parent === parent) { existing = containers[c]; break; }
      }
      if (!existing) {
        existing = { parent: parent, wrappers: [], items: [], offset: 0, running: false, raf: null };
        containers.push(existing);
      }
      existing.wrappers.push(wrapper);
      var items = wrapper.querySelectorAll(".auto-tab-erp-marquee-item");
      items.forEach(function(item) {
        existing.items.push(item);
      });
    });

    containers.forEach(function(container) {
      var speed = 0.5;

      /* Start offset at -100% of one copy (top to bottom means starting off-screen above) */
      var initialized = false;

      function animate() {
        if (!container.running) return;

        var firstItem = container.items[0];
        if (!firstItem) return;
        var itemHeight = firstItem.offsetHeight;

        if (!initialized) {
          container.offset = -itemHeight;
          initialized = true;
        }

        container.offset += speed;

        if (container.offset >= 0) {
          container.offset -= itemHeight;
        }

        var transform = "translateY(" + container.offset + "px)";
        container.items.forEach(function(item) {
          item.style.transform = transform;
          item.style.webkitTransform = transform;
        });

        container.raf = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }

      function start() {
        if (container.running) return;
        container.running = true;
        container.raf = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }

      function stop() {
        container.running = false;
        if (container.raf) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(container.raf);
          container.raf = null;
        }
      }

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        entries.forEach(function(entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            start();
          } else {
            stop();
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.05 });

      observer.observe(container.parent);
    });
  }

  /* ── Circuit Pulse Animation ── */
  var pulseEl = document.querySelectorAll(".circuit-pulse-animation");
  pulseEl.forEach(function(el) {
    var interval = null;
    var CYCLE = 7000;
    var STAGGER = CYCLE * 0.75;
    var FEATHER = 8;
    var RING_WIDTH = 10;
    var t0 = Date.now();

    function frame() {
      var time = Date.now() - t0;
      var rings = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        var elapsed = (time + i * STAGGER) % (CYCLE * 2 - STAGGER);
        if (elapsed > CYCLE) continue;
        var p = elapsed / CYCLE;
        var ringPct = p * 70;
        var a = 1.0;
        if (p < 0.1) a = p / 0.1;
        if (p > 0.8) a = 1.0 - (p - 0.8) / 0.2;
        if (a < 0) a = 0;
        if (a > 1) a = 1;
        if (a > 0.02) rings.push({ pct: ringPct, alpha: a });
      }
      rings.sort(function(a, b) { return a.pct - b.pct; });
      var stops = ["rgba(0,0,0,1) 0%"];
      for (var r = 0; r < rings.length; r++) {
        var ring = rings[r];
        var s = ring.pct - RING_WIDTH / 2 - FEATHER;
        var ps = ring.pct - RING_WIDTH / 2;
        var pe = ring.pct + RING_WIDTH / 2;
        var e = ring.pct + RING_WIDTH / 2 + FEATHER;
        if (s < 1) s = 1;
        if (ps < 2) ps = 2;
        if (pe > 98) pe = 98;
        if (e > 99) e = 99;
        var t = "rgba(0,0,0," + (1 - ring.alpha) + ")";
        stops.push("rgba(0,0,0,1) " + s + "%");
        stops.push(t + " " + ps + "%");
        stops.push(t + " " + pe + "%");
        stops.push("rgba(0,0,0,1) " + e + "%");
      }
      stops.push("rgba(0,0,0,1) 100%");
      var mask = "radial-gradient(circle at center, " + stops.join(", ") + ")";
      el.style.webkitMaskImage = mask;
      el.style.maskImage = mask;
    }

    var pulseObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          if (!interval) {
            t0 = Date.now();
            interval = setInterval(frame, 25);
            frame();
          }
        } else {
          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            interval = null;
          }
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    pulseObserver.observe(el);
  });

})();
</script>
